description: This file defines a LightningJS component called 'NotesList' that manages and displays a list of notes, handles user interactions such as creating notes and navigating the list, and synchronizes with a global store.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: A LightningJS component that renders a list of notes and handles user interaction for note selection and creation.

methods.name: _syncFromStore
methods.description: Synchronizes the component's local state with the global store, updating notes list, selected note ID, and focused index.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with empty title and content by dispatching an action to the store.

methods.name: _moveSelection
methods.description: Moves the note selection up or down within the list based on the delta argument.
